# United Kingdom: Urban population (% of total population)

 In 2024, United Kingdom's Urban population (% of total population) was 83.24. 

 That's up 0.1% from 2023, the highest value on record. 

 The global average for this indicator in 2024 was 62.87 . United Kingdom ranks #50 globally out of 217 reporting countries. Within Europe & Central Asia, it ranks #15 of 58. 

 Source: World Bank Open Data (SP.URB.TOTL.IN.ZS) • Data as of 2024

## About Urban population (% of total population)

Urban population refers to people living in urban areas as defined by national statistical offices. The data are collected and smoothed by United Nations Population Division.
